name: Jordan
label: UI-frustrated listener, YouTube Music curious
who: I use Spotify almost all day for music and podcasts, and I rely on its recommendations and radio to find new songs. I have been frustrated by UI changes and have started looking at other apps such as SoundCloud and YouTube Music.
value_for_money: Little is said directly about price. They value Spotify's recommendations, daily mixes and mix of podcasts and music, and one notes that YouTube Music is a great deal with a strong app.
loyalty: Recommendations and podcasts integrated in one app keep them on Spotify. UI changes that bury library content and add AI DJ features are what push them to consider leaving.
pain_points: UI changes making library and likes harder
likes: Podcasts and music in one app
reasons_to_stay: They value Spotify's recommendations, playlist variety and the mix of podcasts and music in one app, and one says the recommendations alone keep them there. Some still see Spotify's feature set as strong despite the UI complaints.
tone: Exasperated and informal, venting in lowercase or with profanity, but usually explaining the specific feature that bothers them.
